customDescriptions.value: Provide a hardware-in-the-loop interface for active battery emulation — use to connect a real-time battery model to physical BMS hardware for closed-loop HIL testing
Connect arrays of electrical nodes between battery modules in Simscape — use to wire series or parallel cell configurations without manually connecting each cell port
Connect arrays of thermal nodes between battery modules in Simscape — use to wire thermal ports of series/parallel cell configurations for pack-level thermal simulation
Model a battery cell or module as a Simscape physical component with equivalent circuit dynamics — use for system-level electrical simulation with current, voltage, and thermal ports
Model a battery cell using table-based parameterization of OCV, resistance, and time constants vs. SOC and temperature — use when cell characterization data is available from HPPC or EIS testing
Implement constant-current constant-voltage charging protocol — use to generate charge current commands that transition from CC to CV phase at the voltage setpoint for safe Li-ion charging
Estimate total battery capacity online using a Kalman filter — use to track capacity fade over the battery lifetime for accurate SOC scaling and end-of-life prediction
Estimate total battery capacity online using recursive least squares — use when a computationally lighter alternative to Kalman filtering is needed for capacity tracking

customDescriptions.block: Battery Capacity Estimator (Least Squares, Variable Weights)
customDescriptions.value: Estimate battery capacity using weighted recursive least squares — use when measurement quality varies and recent data should be weighted more heavily for faster adaptation
Detect cell contact failures (open connections) by monitoring voltage and temperature anomalies — use in BMS safety logic to identify loose or corroded cell tabs before thermal events
Compute the maximum allowable charging current based on cell voltage, temperature, and SOC — use in BMS to protect cells from overcharge by dynamically limiting charger current demand
Control coolant flow rate and pump speed to regulate battery temperature — use to implement thermal management logic that maintains optimal cell temperature during charging and driving
Monitor pack current against overcurrent and short-circuit thresholds with time-based qualification — use to trigger contactor opening or current derating when sustained overcurrent is detected
Compute the maximum allowable discharging current based on cell voltage, temperature, and SOC — use in BMS to prevent over-discharge and protect cells under high-load conditions
Model a battery using a configurable equivalent circuit (R, RC, or multi-RC) in Simscape — use for detailed electrical dynamics simulation including transient voltage response under pulsed loads
Control heater activation to bring battery temperature into operating range — use in cold-climate BMS to pre-condition cells before charging or high-power discharge
Estimate the maximum available charge and discharge power over a prediction horizon — use for power management in hybrid/electric powertrains to enforce safe operating limits on motor torque requests

Model a battery cell using single-particle electrochemical physics — use when equivalent circuits lack fidelity and internal states like lithium concentration gradients are needed for advanced BMS development
Monitor cell temperatures against over-temperature and under-temperature thresholds — use to trigger thermal protection actions like derating, heating, or emergency shutdown
Monitor cell voltages against overvoltage and undervoltage thresholds — use to trigger charging cutoff, load disconnect, or cell balancing when limits are approached
Implement CC-CV charging with a proportional controller for smooth phase transition — use when a simple feedback controller is preferred over open-loop current reference generation
Estimate SOC differences between individual cells using a Kalman filter — use to monitor cell imbalance in a pack and trigger balancing when delta SOC exceeds thresholds

customDescriptions.block: Cell Delta SOC Estimator (Kalman Filter, Variable Resistance)
customDescriptions.value: Estimate cell SOC differences with online resistance adaptation — use when cell aging causes resistance divergence that biases fixed-model delta SOC estimates
Model a battery charger as a controlled current/voltage source in Simscape — use to simulate charging profiles (CC-CV, pulse, multi-stage) applied to physical battery models
Model a battery test cycler that applies charge/discharge profiles in Simscape — use to simulate standard test procedures (capacity tests, HPPC, drive cycles) on physical battery models
Model a battery discharger as a controlled load in Simscape — use to simulate constant-current, constant-power, or profile-based discharge testing on physical battery models
Model edge cooling of prismatic or pouch cells in Simscape — use to simulate heat extraction through cell edges via cold plates in pack thermal design

Apply debouncing and time-based qualification to raw fault signals — use to prevent nuisance trips from transient sensor noise while ensuring genuine faults are confirmed within response time requirements
Model a fuel cell stack using table-based V-I characteristics in Simscape — use for system-level simulation of hydrogen fuel cell powertrains with electrical and thermal coupling
Model a fuel cell using an equivalent circuit with activation, ohmic, and concentration losses — use for dynamic fuel cell simulation capturing transient voltage response to load steps
Model a frequency-dependent impedance using state-space representation in Simscape — use to capture complex EIS-measured impedance spectra for high-fidelity battery or fuel cell models
Reduced-order thermal model for multiple cells capturing spatial temperature distribution — use for computationally efficient pack thermal simulation that resolves cell-to-cell temperature gradients

customDescriptions.block: Pack Bar SOC Estimator (Adaptive Kalman Filter)
customDescriptions.value: Estimate average pack-level SOC using an adaptive Kalman filter that tunes noise covariances online — use for robust pack SOC display that adapts to changing sensor noise or model uncertainty
Estimate average pack-level SOC using a standard Kalman filter — use as the primary gauge algorithm for displaying remaining energy in a battery pack
Model parallel coolant flow channels for battery thermal management in Simscape — use to simulate flow distribution and thermal performance of manifolded cooling plates
Interface a physical passive balancing circuit with a real-time battery model — use for HIL testing where real balancing FETs interact with simulated cell voltages
Equalize cell voltages in a series-connected pack by dissipating excess energy through bleed resistors — use to implement BMS balancing logic that reduces cell-to-cell SOC variation during charging
Provide a hardware-in-the-loop interface for passive battery emulation — use to output simulated cell voltages to physical BMS sense wires for HIL validation
Estimate cell-level state of charge using an adaptive Kalman filter — use when operating conditions change significantly and fixed filter tuning produces drift

customDescriptions.block: SOC Estimator (Adaptive Kalman Filter, Variable Capacity)
customDescriptions.value: Estimate SOC with adaptive Kalman filtering and online capacity tracking — use for aged batteries where nominal capacity no longer reflects actual usable energy
Estimate SOC by integrating measured current over time — use as a simple baseline estimator or as a complement to model-based methods for short-term SOC tracking
Estimate SOC via coulomb counting with time-varying capacity — use when capacity fade is significant and a fixed Ah reference would cause cumulative SOC error
Estimate cell-level state of charge using an extended Kalman filter with an equivalent circuit model — use as the standard model-based SOC estimation algorithm for BMS applications
Estimate SOC using a Kalman filter with online capacity parameter — use to maintain accurate SOC estimates as the battery ages and total capacity decreases
Estimate state of energy using an adaptive Kalman filter — use when energy-based range prediction is needed and operating conditions vary widely

customDescriptions.block: SOE Estimator (Adaptive Kalman Filter, Variable Energy Capacity)
customDescriptions.value: Estimate SOE with adaptive filtering and online energy capacity tracking — use for aged packs where total energy capacity has degraded from nominal
Estimate state of energy by integrating power over time — use as a simple energy accounting method for applications where voltage variation is small

customDescriptions.block: SOE Estimator (Energy Counting, Variable Energy Capacity)
customDescriptions.value: Estimate SOE via energy integration with time-varying energy capacity — use when simple energy counting is sufficient but capacity fade must be accounted for
Estimate state of energy using a Kalman filter — use for model-based remaining energy prediction that accounts for voltage-dependent available energy

customDescriptions.block: SOE Estimator (Kalman Filter, Variable Energy Capacity)
customDescriptions.value: Estimate SOE using a Kalman filter with online energy capacity tracking — use for accurate remaining range estimation in aged batteries
Estimate state of health based on internal resistance growth — use to track battery degradation over lifetime and predict maintenance or replacement timing
Estimate state of health based on capacity fade relative to nominal — use to quantify usable capacity loss for warranty tracking or second-life battery grading
Model a supercapacitor using an equivalent circuit in Simscape — use for hybrid energy storage systems combining batteries with supercapacitors for peak power buffering
Model U-shaped coolant flow channels in Simscape — use to simulate serpentine or U-turn cooling plate geometries and their effect on temperature uniformity
